otter.title: The otter on the boulder
otter.body: Hauled out on a midstream boulder to eat, working the Cristalino's clearwater in low light.

turtle.title: A turtle and its butterflies
turtle.body: Basking on a river rock, attended by butterflies drinking its tears — a hunt for minerals scarce in the Amazon.

frog.title: Small things, big eyes
frog.body: Found on low vegetation on a night walk, clinging by its adhesive toe pads. Logged at genus level.

kingfisher.title: The largest kingfisher alive
kingfisher.body: The largest kingfisher in the Americas, framed through palm fronds above the water.

jaguar.title: A cub in daylight
jaguar.body: The headline of the trip: a cub, five to eight months old, walking a clearing in daylight.

ocelot.title: The elegant one
ocelot.body: A night encounter with the Pantanal's most elegant small cat. Chain-like rosettes smear into long streaks.

tapir.title: Gardener of the forest
tapir.body: South America's largest land mammal, browsing in the open at golden hour. A gardener of the forest.

marshdeer.title: The continent's largest deer
marshdeer.body: The continent's largest deer, a buck in full antler. A wetland specialist, now classed Vulnerable.

pampasdeer.title: Deer, with bird
pampasdeer.body: A doe crossing open grassland with a passenger — a cattle tyrant riding her back for flushed insects.

macaw.title: The largest parrot alive
macaw.body: A bonded pair of the world's largest flying parrot, cobalt from crown to tail.

jabiru.title: Tallest bird in the Americas
jabiru.body: The tallest flying bird in the Americas, stalking wet grassland with its great upturned bill.

caracara.title: Two falcons and a snake
caracara.body: Two caracaras in a tug-of-war over a snake — falcons that behave like bold ground-striding opportunists.

vulture.title: The yellow-headed one
vulture.body: A marsh-and-grassland vulture that quarters low over open country, finding carrion by scent.

owl.title: Standing on a fence post
owl.body: An owl that lives underground and hunts by day, standing tall on a fence post in warm light.

cardinal.title: Red, white and black
cardinal.body: A crisp red, white and black songbird atop a flowering shrub. Despite the name, it's a tanager.

sp_01.title: Twelve million people, one horizon
sp_01.body: The concrete sea from the hotel window — Brazil starts loud.

closing.body: Thank you for coming along. Shot on an iPhone and a Sony A7CR — sixteen days, four thousand kilometres.
